display.purpose: Landing headline, with a smaller mobile size.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Primary action on the landing page.

components.name: Search trigger
components.css: .ds-search{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:260px;height:36px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--var-color-border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--docs-surface);color:var(--var-color-muted-foreground);font:14px var(--font-sans)}.ds-search kbd{margin-left:auto;padding:1px 6px;border:1px solid var(--var-color-border);border-radius:4px;font:11px var(--font-mono)}.ds-search:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--var-color-ring);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Current navigation link
components.description: A neutral raised row, not accent text.

components.name: Reference table
components.description: Generated props table: mono accent name, mono type, muted description.
components.css: .ds-ref{border-collapse:collapse;border:1px solid var(--var-color-border);font:14px var(--font-sans)}.ds-ref th,.ds-ref td{padding:10px 14px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--var-color-border)}.ds-ref thead th{background:var(--docs-surface);color:var(--var-color-muted-foreground);font-size:12px;font-weight:500}.ds-ref tbody th{color:var(--var-color-primary);font:500 13px var(--font-mono)}

narrative.overview: A quiet, neutral frame modelled on the Radix documentation experience, in which the library's own components are the colour. One scrolling page per component with a generated API reference; a landing page that is a grid of live compositions.
rules: The shell uses --var-* tokens only; colour literals live in src/app/styles/brand.css.
Accent only for primary action, link, focus and selection.
dos: Do keep one palette: change brand.css, not the shell CSS.
Do preserve the e2e hooks (#main-content, .docs-shell, #docs-page-title, labelled demo sections).
Do respect reduced motion without causing hydration differences (useMotionPreference).
donts: Don't add colour literals outside brand.css.
Don't hand-edit src/generated or the PNG brand assets.
Don't use <details> except for the mobile outline.
